property_summary: Scheduling an operation with delay < minDelay must revert; scheduling with delay >= minDelay makes isOperation return true and getTimestamp equals block.timestamp+delay (within the same call context).
Attempting to cancel an operation that is not pending must revert, while cancelling a pending operation succeeds and makes isOperation return false.
If execute(...) succeeds (does not revert) then the operation id becomes done (isOperationDone == true) and executor must have EXECUTOR_ROLE.
If execute(...) returns successfully (does not revert) then the operation becomes done (isOperationDone == true) — expressed as: either execute reverted or isOperationDone(id) holds.
If schedule succeeds (no revert) for delay == 0 then after a subsequent execute call that does not revert the operation becomes done.
